headline: Every gold dispute call leaves out a field the tool requires, and the task is graded by exact string match on those calls, so no correct agent can get credit.

issues.summary: All four gold file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281 calls omit the required customer_max_liability_amount. On replay each one fails with a missing-argument error. ACTION grading compares the inner arguments JSON as a raw string.
evidence: tools.py file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281 signature: customer_max_liability_amount: float (no default)
Replay of gold[6..9]: "Error: Invalid arguments: KnowledgeTools.file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281() missing 1 required positional argument: 'customer_max_liability_amount'"
data_model/tasks.py Action.compare_with_tool_call: compares tool_call.arguments to action arguments with == (inner 'arguments' is a JSON string)
issues.why_it_matters: A working dispute call must include customer_max_liability_amount, so its arguments string can never equal the gold string. Matching would also require identical key order, spacing, and the literal '150.00'. Reward is 0 for every competent agent.
issues.suggested_fix: Regenerate the four gold calls with customer_max_liability_amount, and set compare_args to the semantic keys (for example agent_tool_name only, or switch to DB grading) so JSON spelling does not decide the score.

issues.summary: The duplicate Austin Coffee Roasters charges share a date. Picking btxn_d937eaa1d21d depends on reading the second-listed row as the earlier one under the most-recent-first contract, while 'earliest (first)' also reads naturally as the first one listed.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031: "Dispute the earliest (first) transaction when multiple duplicates exist."
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018: "Transactions are returned in reverse chronological order (most recent first)."
tools.py get_bank_account_transactions_9173: stable sort by date, reverse=True; same-date rows keep stored order (comment: "identifies the later-listed record as the earlier one")
Tool output for chk_dk83f5c2a1_gff: row 2 btxn_ff7d3926dee0 11/11/2025 -67.25, row 3 btxn_d937eaa1d21d 11/11/2025 -67.25
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that takes the top-listed duplicate picks btxn_ff7d3926dee0 and misses gold[8].
issues.suggested_fix: Give the duplicates distinct timestamps, or say in doc_031 that among same-date duplicates in most-recent-first output the lower-listed row is the earliest.

issues.summary: The duplicate charge is set provisional-credit eligible although the customer has not contacted the merchant, a case the 'not required' list covers. The PIN-shared dispute resolves the same overlap the other way.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_032: "Provisional Credit is REQUIRED when ALL of these conditions are met: ... 2. Dispute Category: ... 'duplicate_charge'"

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_032: "Provisional Credit is NOT REQUIRED (but may be offered at discretion) when: ... 2. Customer has not contacted merchant first (for non-fraud disputes) 3. Customer shared their PIN voluntarily (pin_compromised = 'yes_shared')"
gold[8] duplicate_charge contacted_merchant false, provisional_credit_eligible true
gold[9] unauthorized_transaction pin_compromised yes_shared, provisional_credit_eligible false
issues.why_it_matters: With compare_args unset, the boolean is part of the compared string, so an agent applying the merchant-contact condition fails gold[8].
issues.suggested_fix: Make doc_032's REQUIRED and NOT REQUIRED lists mutually exclusive.

solution_check: Reconstructed four disputes: third-party ATM $150 keep_active, goods-not-received $189.50 (provisional false, merchant contacted), duplicate $67.25 keep_active, family-member unauthorized $475 with yes_shared and freeze_pending_investigation. The gold uses the same categories and amounts, but its calls cannot execute, and no real call can string-match them.
prior_note: The task file is unchanged since v1.0.0; the missing required argument still blocks every agent. The duplicate pick now agrees with the v1.0.1 most-recent-first ordering but still needs a non-obvious reading.
notes: Because the gold disputes never execute, the gold also omits the most-severe card action (freeze GFF for freeze_pending_investigation, per doc_031). Under ACTION grading extra calls are ignored, so this does not change scoring; the scorer variant (verified DB) does not apply because reward_basis is ACTION only.
